topic: Demonstration and explanation to carry out various flight servicing as per flight servicing schedule.
syllabus_extract: Demonstration and explanation to carry out various flight servicing as per flight servicing schedule.
specific_objectives: 29.1.1.5 Trainee will be able to explain about various types of Flight Servicing being carried out i.a.w flight servicing cards / Aircraft flight servicing manual.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of Flight Servicing Cards; Identification of Servicing Types; Verification of Schedule Compliance
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of a flight servicing card?
List three common types of flight servicing required for an aircraft.
Why is adherence to the flight servicing schedule critical for airworthiness?

topics: Reference to Aircraft Flight Servicing Manual
development.content:
Definition of Flight Servicing
Importance of Scheduled Maintenance
Role of Flight Servicing Cards
Reference to Aircraft Flight Servicing Manual

Pre-flight Servicing Procedures
In-flight Servicing Requirements
Post-flight Servicing Checks
Documentation and Reporting

Interpretation of Servicing Intervals
Handling Deviations from Schedule
Coordination with Ground Crew
Final Verification Steps

summary_questions: Explain the difference between pre-flight and post-flight servicing tasks.
How does a trainee identify a deviation from the standard flight servicing schedule?
What steps are taken to ensure all flight servicing is properly documented?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report outlining the specific flight servicing requirements for the next scheduled mission, referencing the relevant flight servicing card and manual sections.

pft_rows.syllabus: Practical’s on documentation based on following maintenance evolutions: (a) A defect observed in any system during flying or on ground (b) Any limitation and husbandry defects (c) Any defect cleared by DI/DR (d) Any defect cleared by robbing action (e) Any defect cleared by replacement of component and forecasting its life f) Entries made for ground Run / CTF / MTF g) Acceptance of A/C by pilot for Ground run, CTF & MTF h) Documentation linked to independent checks, supervisory checks and checks on special occasions.
